central_question: 在冻结的四供体配对 gene count 子集中，估计 Dex 相对 untreated 的表达变化，并验证统计设计和数值产物。

scope.reason: 保留下游计数语义、配对设计、归一化、NB检验和多重校正；上游比对不属于本合同。

candidate_processing_reported_by_vignett.annotation: Ensembl75, gene-level; verify frozen package rowRanges metadata before export
candidate_processing_reported_by_vignett.object_separation: airway object is distinct from Salmon demonstrations and gse object

provenance_conflicts.observed: BioC3.23 vignette intermediate regenerated metadata table prints 16 rows and all dex=untrt, while frozen airway object prints 8 samples with paired treatments.
provenance_conflicts.hypothesis: positional GEO metadata parsing is brittle
provenance_conflicts.required_resolution: Compare immutable package sample_table.csv and colData(airway) with semantic GSM fields; do not use positional field renaming as authority.

claims_as_hypotheses: Dex is associated with transcript expression changes in the specified airway smooth muscle cell setting; no expected gene names or values are public oracle inputs.
source_graph: GSE52778 -> airway1.32.0 airway object -> immutable exported counts and metadata
GSE52778 -> FPKM / author diff -> private source audit only
operations: validate count units, sample mapping and paired design
estimate normalization and NB model using donor + condition
compute Dex/untreated contrast, multiple-testing adjustment and objective artifacts
outputs: executable analysis script for Terminal wrapper
limits: one study and four paired donors
no protein mechanism, clinical efficacy or cross-population generalization
public teaching data may have pretraining contamination

eligibility.difficulty: statistical design, units, count-model fitting and multiple testing; not file size

release_blockers: package object and sample mapping conflict resolution
public prefilter and missing-value rules frozen against real data
allowed methods and multiple reference paths
empirical tolerances and scorer unit weights
public/private isolation and independent blind evaluations
